html:
The Uganda-Tanzania War was fought from October 1978 to June 1979, after Idi Amin's army invaded the Kagera region of northern Tanzania, and ended with the fall of Amin.

Julius Nyerere answered by mobilising the Tanzanian army, which drove the invaders out and pushed into Uganda alongside Ugandan exile forces. Libya sent troops to help Amin, but they were defeated.

Kampala fell on 11 April 1979, and Amin fled into exile, finally settling in Saudi Arabia. The war cost Tanzania dearly, and the OAU was divided over a member state removing another's ruler. Uganda went on to years of disputed rule under Obote.
sum: The Uganda-Tanzania War was fought from October 1978 to June 1979, after Idi Amin's army invaded the Kagera region of northern Tanzania, and ended with the fall of Amin.
